    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AppShell
    Hosts cashier and manager navigation with a shared database worker and connection status.
    CashierView
    Cashier workflow for browsing drinks, capturing customizations, and submitting orders.
    CheckoutCart
    An immutable checkout snapshot used to calculate totals and build persistence requests.
    CheckoutPolicy
    Defines shared sales tax and drink customization choices for checkout.
    Database
    Provides blocking database access for the cashier catalog and repositories.
    DatabaseConfig
    Loads PostgreSQL credentials from a properties file and environment overrides.
    EmployeeRepository
    Employee maintenance preserves IDs and historical order associations.
    EmployeeRepository.Employee
    An employee row used for manager maintenance and cashier selection.
    InventoryRepository
    Inventory operations; each mutation is a single atomic PostgreSQL statement.
    InventoryRepository.InventoryItem
    An inventory snapshot containing stocking rules and optional topping pricing.
    ManagerView
    Hosts inventory, menu, employee, and sales screens on the JavaFX application thread.
    MenuRepository
    Menu metadata and recipes are saved atomically; existing sales retain purchase prices.
    MenuRepository.MenuDraft
    Validated menu details ready for insertion or replacement.
    MenuRepository.MenuItem
    A menu item and its recipe loaded from a consistent database snapshot.
    MenuRepository.RecipePart
    One inventory requirement for a single serving of a menu item.
    OrderItemSelection
    Captures one drink configuration and its quantity before checkout starts.
    OrderRepository
    Persists checkout and inventory consumption together.
    OrderRepository.OrderLine
    A group of identical drinks with shared ice, sugar, and extra toppings.
    OrderRepository.OrderReceipt
    Amounts and identifier returned after an order has committed successfully.
    OrderRepository.OrderRequest
    Validated checkout input captured before database work begins.
    OrderRepository.Topping
    A priced extra topping to apply to every drink in an order line.
    PosApplication
    Launches the JavaFX point-of-sale application and owns its shared database worker.
    Product
    An immutable cashier catalog item with an exact decimal base price and optional seasonal dates.
    ReportRepository
    Runs only the project's packaged, allowlisted report queries.
    ReportRepository.ItemSales
    Sales of one menu item with drink and topping revenue kept separately.
    ReportRepository.Report
    Allowlisted manager reports mapped to packaged SQL resources.
    ReportRepository.ReportTable
    A report result with stable column order and immutable rows.
    ReportRepository.SalesReport
    Menu item sales in an inclusive date range.
    ReportRepository.XReportHour
    Sales activity recorded during one hour of the selected business date.
    ReportRepository.XReportSummary
    Daily totals and hourly sales without closing the register or resetting sales.
    ToppingOption
    An immutable topping choice and quoted price loaded for the cashier popup.
